label: Basic
description: Basic dialog. Best for a 2 field profile edit form with Cancel and Save changes in the footer, and a corner close button.

label: Scrollable Content
description: Dialog with scrollable content. Best for read only text in a body capped at most of the screen that scrolls under the title, with no footer.

label: Sticky Footer
description: Dialog with scrollable content and a footer that stays. Best for a scrolling body above a footer whose Close button stays in view.

label: No Close Button
description: Dialog without a close button. Best for a notice with no corner X, leaving a footer Close button as the visible way out.

label: Custom Close Button
description: Dialog with a custom close button. Best for a profile form whose corner close button becomes a round bordered chip floating past the top right edge.

label: Full-Screen
description: Full-screen dialog with a fixed header and footer. Best for a near full screen dialog with bordered header and footer bars around a scrolling body.

label: Destructive Confirmation
description: Confirmation dialog with a destructive action. Best for a delete prompt laid out as a dialog with a warning icon and a destructive button.

label: Cookie Consent
description: Cookie consent dialog. Best for cookie category switches with a locked essential row and Save preferences or Accept all actions.

label: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Dialog with a keyboard shortcuts list. Best for a read only shortcut reference in 2 columns of key chords in a wider dialog, for a hardware keyboard.

label: Full Width Button
description: Dialog with one full width button. Best for a session timeout notice with one full width Sign in again button and no Cancel; a tap outside does not close it.
